reply.body:
Hi Tom,

Thanks to you and Jen for going through everything. We'll fix the year to 2009, add EV chargers near generators, and soften the headline. Option B in your truck green it is.

The 8 town pages go beyond what our current agreement covers, which includes up to 2 location pages. I'll send you a quote for adding the others.

On the service pages, I'll confirm timing with the team.

Please don't send logins by email; invite us as a user instead, and I'd suggest changing that GoDaddy password.

Thanks for the logo files and the Analytics invite.
